code_review: Grok grok-4.6 high returned pass with no concrete defects; reviewed sources are hash-bound and unchanged.
accepted_limits: Existing target length is derived from all normal TRAIN, including held C; subsequent member geometry is A-only.
Four A sets overlap; rows may contain duplicate waveform values. No independent-model or novel-waveform guarantee is claimed.
The three original full-F controls use their original full fitting population. The first five score paths remain the original Exp510 implementation.
The independent verifier reconstructs role indices and component means and checks stored gradients, but does not regenerate geometry and full gradients from feature matrices.
The pilot-only implementation has no full TEST runner; all four verified gates are required before creating and qualifying the separate full-evaluation stage.
local_review: Reviewed upstream load_normal_train TRAIN-normal query, crossfit split, fixed MiniRocket/OAS factory and original contribution/objective paths; tested member isolation, four-role coverage, arithmetic pooling and exact first-head replay.

acceleration.initial_assessment: The synthetic benchmark changing all four solver objective paths gave warm speedups around 1.14. It is preserved without rewriting its result.
acceleration.production_assessment: A separate fixed three-round benchmark preserves original Exp510 member0 and all five controls, changing only members1-3. All scores/rankings/candidates agree and the original five are exact. Numba median speedup is 0.9988691289624198; Torch CPU is 0.9995306844088834. Neither qualifies at 1.1x, including first-call overhead.
acceleration.gpu: Actual MLX GPU and MPS float64 operations are unsupported in the installed environment.
acceleration.statistics: Existing NumPy reductions/quantiles and SciPy distances are retained. No demonstrated Numba/GPU gain justifies replacing these small audit and aggregation stages.
